record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: Because the two-fold cover of Sp_{2n}(E) splits over Sp_{2n}(F), there is no direct non-archimedean analogue of the finite-field symplectic branching problem. The paper therefore asks whether one should instead pass to a four-fold cover of Sp_{2n}(E), assuming E contains the fourth roots of unity, in order to formulate and study an analogous branching problem over non-archimedean local fields.

evidence.quote: It is curious that since the two fold cover of Sp2n(E) splits over Sp2n(F), there is no analogous problem for non-archimedean local fields. Perhaps, one could go to four fold cover of Sp2n(E) (if the 4th roots of unity are there in E) to study the analogous branching problem?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let F be a non-archimedean local field of characteristic zero and let E/F be a quadratic extension. Assume that E contains the fourth roots of unity. The metaplectic two-fold cover Mp_{2n}(E) → Sp_{2n}(E) is known to split canonically over the subgroup Sp_{2n}(F); consequently the naive analogue, over the local field F, of the symplectic branching problem from Sp_{2n}(F_q^2) (with its Weil/metaplectic representation) restricted to Sp_{2n}(F_q) does not carry over directly to the non-archimedean setting via the two-fold cover.

To obtain a non-trivial analogue, consider instead the four-fold central cover

    1 → μ_4 → \widetilde{Sp}_{2n}(E)^{(4)} → Sp_{2n}(E) → 1

of Sp_{2n}(E) (which exists because μ_4 ⊂ E). Let π be a genuine irreducible smooth representation of \widetilde{Sp}_{2n}(E)^{(4)} (in particular, an analogue of the Weil representation on this cover), and let H ⊂ \widetilde{Sp}_{2n}(E)^{(4)} denote the preimage of Sp_{2n}(F) under the covering map.

Formulate, and study, a branching problem of Gan–Gross–Prasad type describing

    Hom_H(π, σ)

as σ ranges over irreducible (genuine) smooth representations of H. In particular, determine whether and how the four-fold cover \widetilde{Sp}_{2n}(E)^{(4)} restricted to (the preimage of) Sp_{2n}(F) gives rise to a well-posed branching/multiplicity problem, and identify the correct statement of a multiplicity-one theorem and an epsilon-factor type formula for the relevant Hom spaces in this setting.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a speculative direction for formulating a non-archimedean analogue of a finite-field symplectic branching problem via a four-fold metaplectic cover. No published resolution or systematic study of this specific branching problem on a four-fold cover of Sp_{2n}(E) over the subgroup Sp_{2n}(F) was located, so it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Twisted GGP problems and conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad problems including remarks on covers of symplectic groups.
status_evidence.claim: The four-fold cover analogue is raised as a speculative question rather than a resolved result.
